Discover Pure Moringa Leaf Powder from Tradenest Naturals

Moringa leaf powder is a bright green, finely milled ingredient made from dried Moringa oleifera leaves. Tradenest Naturals is one of the Indian moringa leaf powder manufacturers supplying it in bulk to supplement brands, tea blenders and food manufacturers abroad. We turn tender green leaves into a smooth powder with steady colour and particle size from batch to batch. As a moringa leaf powder exporter based in Surat, we ship worldwide from India. We also offer OEM and private label packing for brands that want a ready retail product.

How We Process Moringa Leaves

Good powder starts with good leaves. Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers who harvest young, tender leaves. We wash the leaves and sort out stems and foreign matter. The leaves are then dehydrated at low temperature, which helps keep the natural green colour and fresh, grassy aroma. After drying, the material is milled and sieved to produce our moringa leaf powder 100 mesh grade, with a standard specification of 80-100 mesh. The fine, even texture blends well into drinks, capsules and cosmetic bases. A final sieving step removes any coarse particles before packing.

Quality Checks and Documentation

We check every lot for colour, aroma, texture and moisture before it is packed. Our processing area follows food hygiene practices required under our FSSAI licence. Our pure moringa powder bulk price is quoted per kilogram, with the batch details listed on the quotation. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation. If your market or customer needs extra assurance, third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. The powder is supplied as plain dried leaf, with no added colours, preservatives or fillers.

Key Applications Across Diverse Industries

Bulk moringa leaf powder is used in many product categories. Food and beverage brands add it to green smoothies, juice blends and shake mixes. Supplement companies fill it into capsules and tablets. Cosmetic brands use it in face masks and hair care products. It is also used in herbal tea blends and, in some markets, in animal feed premixes.

Why Partner With Tradenest Naturals?

Choosing a bulk moringa leaf powder supplier india is about steady supply, clear specifications and easy communication. We are an IEC registered exporter and give export documentation support with every shipment. We offer custom packaging and help with freight arrangements to your port. Contact us to request a quote, order samples or discuss your private label needs.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is the minimum order quantity for moringa leaf powder manufacturers?

Our minimum order quantity (MOQ) is 5 Kg. This makes it easy to start with a trial order before moving to larger bulk volumes. Private label projects are quoted separately based on your packaging.

What certifications and quality standards apply?

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter. We share a product specification sheet with every quotation and support you with export documents. Third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

We pack in moisture-resistant stand-up pouches, fibre drums and export-grade HDPE bags. Stored in cool, dry conditions away from direct sunlight, the powder has a shelf life of 24 months.

What are the typical specifications (mesh, moisture, purity)?

Our standard powder is low-temperature dehydrated, with an 80-100 mesh size and moisture below 8.0%. It is plain moringa leaf with no additives.

What is the lead time and how do I request a sample or quote?

Lead time depends on order size and packing format, and we confirm it on each quotation. You can request a sample or a commercial quote by contacting our sales team through our website.
